summary: Independent Owner-amendment review of A0003 (SPEC layer; targets T049, T050, T052, T053, T063, T064, T084, T085). Scope and identity: candidate 95dff9a is a single commit whose parent is base b3d58e7, and the amendment worktree is clean at exactly that SHA. It changes 12 paths: docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md, the eight target contracts, todo/config.yaml, and the two finish-amendment records (todo/amendments/A0003/request.json, planner-001.json) that the controller itself writes, matching the A0001/A0002 precedent. No src/, tests/, tools/, .claude/, docs/intent/, todo/schemas/, todo/reviews/, todo/evidence/, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, README or non-target contract changed; git diff --check is clean. Recorded direction and boundaries: the runtime record .git/robinhood-lp-workflow/A0003-request.json is byte-identical to the committed request record, and .git/robinhood-lp-workflow/A0003.json records AWAITING_REVIEW, attempt 1, layer SPEC, exactly the eight target tasks, base b3d58e7 and candidate 95dff9a. All eight targets remain PLANNED at attempt 0, and a flattened diff of todo/config.yaml shows exactly one changed field, spec_revision v1-2026-09-19-research-universe to v1-2026-09-19-numeraire-web-console; no status, attempt, evidence pointer, commit SHA, review record, approval datum, dependency field or agent-runtime setting moved. No dependency edit exists in either config or contract, and each contract's Dependencies block is byte-identical to base and equal to its config depends_on list. Direction conformance, item by item: 1(a) WEB-PAGE-008..011 were added, each stating what it shows and each closing with an explicit statement that T103 owns it and that it lies outside T084's acceptance, and T103's existing contract already claims those four pages, so specification and contract agree. 1(b) WEB-PAGE-004, the strategy research/backtest results page, now requires regime and time-slice breakdown with the independent-episode count and an uncertainty interval per slice, and the UNCERTAIN fallback instead of a bare point estimate. 1(c) WEB-GLOBAL-001 now requires every page to show the active dataset version and the reporting numeraire (USDG, qualified USD stablecoin, or ETH labelled as volatile display), makes a RELATIVE_ONLY dataset textually and visually distinguishable, and forbids any USD-denominated field or dollar sign on RELATIVE_ONLY results, matching Intent G-NUMERAIRE-02 and ADR-014. 1(d) exactly the four directed bullets were appended to section 4. 1(e) sections 5 and 6 are byte-identical to base, every pre-existing page and clause is retained, and the only change to pre-existing text is the header date. Each contract edit maps to its directed item: T053 applies the ADR-014 hierarchy while keeping USDG mandatory for the active execution pool and both 5-minute rules and adding a RELATIVE_ONLY path with no USD-denominated field anywhere; T052 labels every rebalancing-loss figure a proxy with its declared reference (LP_METRICS M-LVR-001, reference M-BM-002) and adds breakeven volatility M-BE-001 solved from the replay's own fee and rebalancing series with window and annualisation; T049 fixes the numeraire boundary at the capital envelope and its reporting while keeping the integer and liquidityDelta discipline; T050 draws the T050/T101 label boundary; T063 records the dataset version and reporting numeraire in the manifest; T064 makes pool holdout the primary generalisation test with horizon-derived purge and embargo; T084 narrows acceptance to the requirements owned by the P08 web-console tasks and excludes the four T103 pages; T085 puts research dataset and model definitions through the versioned write path while forbidding any execution-approval reading or execution-shaped reachability. No existing acceptance clause was removed or weakened (T084's narrowing is itself the directed change), and no unrelated requirement was introduced: every added identifier resolves (ADR-004, ADR-014, ADR-015, LP_METRICS M-BM-002/M-LVR-001/M-BE-001, DATASET_AND_EVALUATION DS-021/DS-022, T101, T103), no superseded T022/T023/T038 is cited in any changed line, and no URL, API key, authorization header or environment value was added. docs/intent/ and the accepted ADRs are cited only, never reopened. Verification run: python -m tools.workflow validate reports OK; tests/test_workflow_contracts.py and tests/test_no_signing_paths.py pass 10/10 with PYTHONPATH=src (plain import of robinhood_lp fails only because the environment's editable install points at a removed worktree, a pre-existing host condition); the full suite reports 1144 passed, 6 skipped and one failure, test_abi_artifacts::test_artifact_byte_matches_regenerated_oracle_output, caused solely by tools/oracle/lib (v4-core, v4-periphery) existing only in the main checkout and not in this detached review worktree, unrelated to a docs-only candidate. Assessed residuals, requiring no change here: the three items the planner recorded as unresolved are consequences of the recorded direction's own path and dependency constraints rather than defects. First, docs/implement/TRACEABILITY.md is now stale (seven-page row, WEB-* mapped to T084-T086), but that file is explicitly non-authoritative and cannot be edited in any planning layer, and T096 is already charged with rebuilding it. Second, T084 has no dependency edge on T064/T101 for the new regime and episode display data, but the direction forbade dependency edits, the clause is a display requirement with the UNCERTAIN fallback, and T084's other dependencies (T072, T080) already order it after T064 in practice. Third, the pre-existing section-4 position-chart bullet still names a USDG equivalent while the new global rule governs RELATIVE_ONLY pages; the global rule and Intent G-NUMERAIRE-02 resolve that case, and editing the bullet was not authorised. The retained FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE_6C31778 headers match the direction's requirement to keep contract identity and the A0002 precedent. Verdict PASS: the amendment faithfully implements the exact recorded Owner direction, stays inside the SPEC-layer paths and the single config field, keeps dependency and identity fields consistent across config and contracts, preserves every existing acceptance standard, adds nothing unrelated, and resolves the reported inconsistency.
